classification.question_topic: Asking if others have similar experiences: half-awake/half-dreaming state with a loud crowd/conference-room-like setting conveying messages; also asking about “annoying”/overwhelming dream messages and other experienced dream workers.

meta.initial_emotion: crazy ptsd symptoms that day; chose to shut eyes
meta.final_emotion: laughed; pulled self up out of the dream

position.relative_to: perceived while stepping through a 'veil or door of the dreamworld' during half-dreaming/half-awake state

qualities.raw_description: “seeing and hearing a crowd of people… in a conference room or something… talking over each other… all trying to tell me something”

connections.qualities: Dream-entry described as “step my foot through the veil or door of the dreamworld (half dreaming, half awake)” and then “pulled myself up out of the dream.”

boundaries.description: A “veil or door of the dreamworld” encountered while drifting into a nap; author describes stepping a foot through it.

interactions.description: Observed/heard a crowd in a conference-room-like setting trying to convey a message; people were talking over each other.

entities_involved.description: A crowd of people “talking over each other” and “trying to tell me something.”

interactions.description: Dreamer deliberately exited the dream/half-dream state: “pulled myself up out of the dream and laughed… ‘I do not have the time today conference room entities!’”
Separate past experience after drinking a “neuro sleep drink”: had worst migraine; went to bed and had “nightmares of shapes trying to talk to me.”

entities_involved.description: “shapes trying to talk to me” (described as “fever dream style”).

extraction.extraction_notes: Post is primarily a question; dream content is brief and occurs in a half-awake/half-dreaming state. Spatial detail limited to a “conference room or something” and a “veil or door” boundary into the dreamworld. The ‘neuro sleep drink’ episode is described as a separate past event without specific setting beyond going to bed.
